metadata.title: Retro Soul Group Portrait with Rainbow Aura

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, triangular group portrait of four individuals with large Afro hairstyles, set against a soft, airbrushed rainbow aura. The composition is anchored by a central figure at the bottom, with three others radiating upward, framed by a curved, decorative script title at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Text follows the arc of the rainbow glow
Faces are arranged in a tiered, overlapping pyramid
Warm skin tones contrast against the cool purple and green of the aura
Soft lighting emphasizes the texture of the hair and smiles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects occupy 80% of the frame in a clustered formation; the bottom-center figure is the largest and closest.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central bottom face acts as the primary anchor, leading the eye upward to the flanking figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular movement starting from the bottom face, moving up the sides to the arched text, and back down through the central top face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily located in the upper corners where the rainbow gradient is most visible.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks of the hair and skin provide the structural weight.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Soft rainbow hues (purple, yellow, green) provide a luminous backdrop.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep purple for the primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background glow against mid-tone, warm photographic values.

letterConstructionRules: Large, circular loops on ascenders and descenders
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 's' has a tight, bulbous curve

composition.relationshipToImage: Frames the heads of the subjects

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative script paired with minimal, small sans-serif metadata at the very top edge.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the thick, rounded 70s script aesthetic
Similar weight and roundness if a script is not used

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a soft-focus group portrait of four Black individuals with large 70s-style Afro hairstyles, arranged in a pyramid. Apply a soft, airbrushed rainbow glow (purple, yellow, green) behind their heads. Use warm, vintage film lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a title in a thick, rounded purple script font, arched across the top of the image following the curve of the rainbow glow.

verificationChecks: Is the text following a smooth arc?
Is the rainbow glow soft and blended?
Are the hairstyles prominent and textured?
Is the color palette warm and nostalgic?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the portrait
mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness issues
Specific tracklist text at the top
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not obscure the faces
Check that the rainbow glow feels integrated, not like a separate layer
Verify the 70s film grain and texture are present
Confirm the script font is sufficiently bold and rounded
recipe.reuseFormula: Group Portrait + Pyramid Composition + Soft Rainbow Airbrush + Arched Round Script Title = 70s Soul Aesthetic
